name: LinkedIn Recruiter: compose bulk InMail from a template ({Nombre} chip) — gated
description: Messages a project's UNCONTACTED candidates with a template {{body}} in a UNIFIED per-page loop: for each page of the native 'uncontacted' stage (SHORTLISTED) it messages → adds the {{note_text}} contact note → moves that page to 'contacted', so messaged == noted == moved. Replaces each literal {Name}/{Nombre} token with the LinkedIn variable CHIP. Sets the subject (handles the subject-reveal quirk). send=false (default) STOPS for a snapshot preview (page 1, no mutation); send=true sends REAL InMail + notes + moves. Params: project_url, body, subject, note_text, send.
